text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- New massacres of villagers in Blida and Ain Defla provinces, south of Algiers. As bomb attacks resume in Algiers, more people were slaughtered in the Mitidja area, south of Algiers. Thirty-eight people were killed in Blida region and more than 40 villagers died in dreadful conditions in Ain Defla.
- "Terrorists" kill 38 people in Sidi el Madani village in Blida and more than 40 in Ain Defla area. Scores of villagers were wounded as they fled the massacre.
- More than 30 "terrorists" were killed by security forces in Sidi Bouzid hamlet in Blida at the end of offensive by government forces there.
- Opposition Socialist Forces Front (FFS) appoints Ahmed Djeddai as the party first secretary replacing Seddik Debaili, who was elected to the National Assembly (lower house).
